fact: INSTAT's Annuaire statistique du Mali 2024, issued April 2026, publishes 2020-2024 statistics compiled from ministry records: health facility reports (Annuaire SNISS 2020-2023), justice and prison records (CPS/SJ activity reports, CPS/SCJ), police records (DGPN activity report 2024) and gendarmerie road-accident counts, social services (SISo), and sector records on livestock (DNPIA), forests (DGEF) and public debt (DGDP), as a successor to the 2023 edition.
title: Annuaire statistique du Mali 2024
